name: Drives
author: Profit94
description: Removable drives in the bar: USB sticks, SD cards and external SSD, HDD or NVMe disks. Notifies on attach and removal, opens new drives in the file manager, and ejects them safely.

barWidget.description: Appears while a removable drive is attached. Click for the drive cards and their actions.

schema.label: Open new drives in the file manager
Notify when a drive is attached or removed
Play a sound when a drive is attached or removed
Keep the icon when no drive is attached
